newsitem.title: USA: American Classic to sell New Orleans hotel.
newsitem.headline: American Classic to sell New Orleans hotel.

text.p: American Classic Voyages Co said on Tuesday that it agreed to sell its subsidiary, which owns the Maison Dupuy Hotel in New Orleans to Thayer Lodging Group for about $22 million in cash.
The deal also includes a profit participation agreement that could pay up to an additional $2 million within the next seven years, the company said.
The deal to sell the the 198-room French Quarter hotel, which is the company's only hotel property, is expected to close on October 16.
American Classic, which purchased the hotel in 1985 for $12 million, said it will use the proceeds of the deal to reduce bank debt and fund its capital expenditures.
